title: action audio.play: data
description: Play audio into the room through the bot's mic (TTS, alerts, music drops). mic=auto grabs a slot if the platform needs one and waits up to wait_for_slot_ms for a free one. Long-running: the connector sends final=false results (queued, playing) before the final one.

caption.description: Text posted to the room when playback starts (for people who cannot hear).
